validation_ack.reason: FY2022 basic loss per share (-11.55) uses a weighted average of 13,457 million shares (FS2022 Note 23, PDF p. 88: loss 155,381,289 thousand / 13,457m): the Feb-2022 rights issue (PUT I, +5,785,272,000 shares) counts only from Feb, and the Dec-2022 PUT II shares (+4,560,722,760) not at all because they were still a capital deposit fund at 31 Dec 2022 (Note 22). shares_out is the 18,381,094,760 shares listed on IDX at year-end (AR2022 PDF p. 22). -11.55 x 13,457m = -155.4bn = reported loss; the gap is real.

FY2023 basic EPS 11 uses a weighted average of 16,226 million shares (FS2023 Note 23, PDF p. 90), because the 4,560,722,760 PUT II shares were legally issued only during 2023, while shares_out is the year-end 18,173,312,360 outstanding (FS2023 Note 19). 177,972m / 16,226m = 10.97 -> 11 as printed; the gap is real, not a share_basis error.

Bank Amar AR2020 (PDF p. 20, Kinerja Saham) prints the Q4-2020 close as Rp288, which equals the 23 Dec 2020 close in the price source; the last 2020 session (30 Dec 2020) closed at Rp284. The AR appears to quote an earlier session; neither source is edited.

Bank Amar AR2023 (PDF p. 28, Kinerja Saham) prints the Q4-2023 close as Rp322, which equals the 28 Dec 2023 close in the price source; the last 2023 session (29 Dec 2023) closed at Rp320. The AR appears to quote an earlier session; neither source is edited.

research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: amarbank.co.id returns HTTP 403 (Google Cloud front end) to this server; no challenge was bypassed. Page listings (report pages, investor news, media) were read from Internet Archive snapshots of amarbank.co.id and, for pages newer than the last snapshot, with the WebFetch tool. All PDFs were downloaded DIRECTLY from the bank's own public document bucket https://storage.googleapis.com/amarbank-new/prod/document/ - the exact URLs the amarbank.co.id report pages link to (stored as source_url). Dividend and rights schedules come from KSEI notices downloaded directly from web.ksei.co.id (the Indonesian CSD relaying the issuer's notification; same treatment as BRIS/BMRI). See sources.md.

ENTITY / BASIS: PT Bank Amar Indonesia Tbk (formerly PT Anglomas International Bank; renamed 2014; Tbk since 2019; head office moved from Surabaya to Jakarta in 2024). Digital lender (Tunaiku unsecured micro/consumer loans; Amar Bank / Senyumku digital savings). Controlled by Tolaram Pte. Ltd. (75.25% at end-2025, ultimate parent Tolaram Family Trust). The bank has NO subsidiaries: its stand-alone audited FS ('Laporan keuangan') are the whole group, so money figures carry basis 'consolidated' as SCHEMA rule 3 requires and the OJK ratios carry 'bank_only'. Conventional bank, no sharia unit (sharia=false). KBMI 1 (Tier 1 Rp3.43tn at end-2025).

UNITS: FS2019-FS2022 are printed in Rp THOUSAND (ribuan) and were divided by 1,000,000; FS2023-FS2025 and all published reports are in Rp MILLION (divided by 1,000). No restatements: each year's comparative column in the next FS equals the originally reported figure (checked FY2019-FY2024).

CORPORATE ACTIONS (2019-01-01 to 2026-11-03): two rights issues only - PUT I 100:72 at Rp173 (ex 14 Feb 2022) and PUT II 100:33 at Rp280 (ex 5 Dec 2022). NO stock split, reverse split or bonus issue since listing: nominal Rp100 since the IPO (FS2025 PDF p. 16; AR2020 PDF p. 20 states no split/reverse split/stock dividend/bonus shares in 2020). The 9 Jan 2020 IPO (1,206,068,500 shares at Rp174) was a DIVESTMENT by Tolaram Group Inc. (existing shares, no new shares; FS2025 Note 1b) and is not a corporate action here. PRE-LISTING (not recorded as corporate actions, no ex-date exists): May 2019 private capital increase 500,000 -> 803,510 shares at Rp1,000,000 nominal partly via loan conversion, and the 26 Aug 2019 deed (No. 277) that changed nominal Rp1,000,000 -> Rp100 (a 1:10,000 nominal change, 803,510 -> 8,035,100,000 shares) before the listing (FS2019 Note 19, PDF pp. 54-55; FS2025 Note 1a). Treasury-share buybacks (207,782,400 shares in Sep-Dec 2023, 367,421,455 cumulative by end-2024) and the 2024 ESOP (162.5m options from treasury stock) are not rights/bonus issues. The column 'cadangan kompensasi atas saham bonus' in FS2024/FS2025 equity refers to employee share compensation, not a bonus issue to shareholders.
